# Enter your birthdate
birthdate <- as.POSIXct("1997-06-06 14:00:00",
                        tz = "Africa/Kigali")

# Get the current date and time
now <- Sys.time()

# Calculate the difference
time_lived <- difftime(now, birthdate, units = "hours")

# Display total hours and days
print(time_lived)
print(as.numeric(time_lived) / 24)
